findings.title: Subagent display depends on agent mode; mode=subagent is filtered from UI selector
findings.rationale: The prompt UI uses local.agent.current() which is populated from agents where mode != 'subagent'. If a subagent is configured with mode=subagent, the UI cannot select it and will keep showing the last primary agent. If a subagent is mode=all (default when not specified), it will display correctly, explaining the intermittent behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: For child sessions, render the session agent directly (from last user message) or allow subagents in the local list with read-only selection.
